title: PG-SFT: Balancing Capability Acquisition and Retention in Offline Agent Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.00949v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on offline agent trajectories is the standard approach for training specialized tool-using agents, but forcing models to imitate reasoning and actions token by token may harm other capabilities (e.g., general reasoning, tool calling, code generation) of the base model. In this work, we focus on studying \emph{how to better balance the trade-off between acquiring new capabilities and preserving existing ones during agent trace SFT}. By comparing several baselines in our setup, standard SFT improves the target benchmark while lowering several non-target benchmark scores; meanwhile, simply constraining distributional drift using KL penalty or limiting the update magnitude did not avoid this regression trend. Motivated by recent token-wise adaptive learning objectives, this work proposes \textbf{Privilege-Guided SFT (PG-SFT)} to leverage turn-level information gain of agent trajectories as an indicator to adjust

translated_title: PG-SFT：在离线智能体微调中平衡能力获取与保留
translated_abstract: 在离线智能体轨迹上进行监督微调（SFT）是训练专用工具使用智能体的标准方法，但强制模型逐词元地模仿推理和动作可能会损害基础模型的其他能力（例如通用推理、工具调用、代码生成）。本工作重点研究如何在智能体轨迹SFT过程中更好地平衡获取新能力与保留现有能力之间的权衡。通过在实验设置中对比多个基线方法，标准SFT在提升目标基准成绩的同时降低了若干非目标基准的分数；同时，仅使用KL惩罚约束分布漂移或限制更新幅度并不能避免这种性能退化趋势。受近期词元级自适应学习目标的启发，本工作提出特权引导监督微调（PG-SFT），利用智能体轨迹的轮次级信息增益作为指标来调整微调过程。
tldr: 提出PG-SFT方法，利用智能体轨迹的轮次级信息增益作为指标来引导监督微调，从而在离线智能体微调中更好地平衡新能力获取与既有能力保留之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: Proposes PG-SFT, which leverages turn-level information gain of agent trajectories to guide supervised fine-tuning, better balancing the trade-off between acquiring new capabilities and retaining existing ones in offline agent fine-tuning.
